steps.en: Install the CLI and start it in the project folder
steps.zh: 装上 CLI，在项目目录里启动

steps.en: Connect a subscription or an API key
steps.zh: 连上订阅或填入 API key

steps.en: Saves the credentials in the agent directory
steps.zh: 把凭证存进 agent 目录

steps.en: Put your own instructions, skills and extensions in the project
steps.zh: 把你自己的指令、技能和扩展放进项目

component.zh: 技能 · 模板 · 扩展

steps.en: Loads those project resources once you grant project trust
steps.zh: 你授予项目信任后，加载这些项目资源

steps.en: Reads files, runs commands and edits content, one turn at a time
steps.zh: 读文件、跑命令、改内容，一轮一轮推进

value.en: You stop adopting a built-in agent wholesale: a small loop whose behaviour comes from files in your repo, which it can also write itself
value.zh: 你不用整体接受一个内置的 agent：循环很小，它做什么由你仓库里的文件决定，而那些文件它自己也能写

sources: packages/coding-agent/README.md (npm install -g --ignore-scripts @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent; Node.js 22.19 or newer; curl -fsSL https://pi.dev/install.sh | sh; cd /path/to/project; pi; /login; adapt Pi to your workflow via prompt templates, skills, extensions and themes; new-contributor issues and PRs are closed automatically)

packages/coding-agent/docs/configuration.md (agent directory defaults to ~/.pi/agent and holds auth.json, extensions/, skills/, prompts/, themes/; project .pi/ loads after project trust; PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR moves the agent directory; /settings and /reload)

packages/coding-agent/docs/how-pi-works.md (one turn = request, streamed tool calls, results; sessions are JSONL trees where each entry refers to its parent; compaction inserts a summary entry; extensions are TypeScript modules loaded into the Pi process; enabled tools use the operating-system permissions of the Pi process)
packages/coding-agent/docs/index.md (print mode, JSON event stream mode, RPC mode and the TypeScript SDK all use the same agent and session mechanisms; project trust does not sandbox tool calls)
